title: Engine test B2: GSAP (RightNow rebuild, new harness)
sourceFormatNote: Exact saved scene source. .txt suffix keeps this editor-harness code out of the Next.js application TypeScript build.

originalMedia.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: original landscape backdrop for a 1920x1080 retro computer launch motion film. Generate ONE empty 16:9 wide photograph, no text, no logos, no UI. A single smooth bright green grassy hill filling the lower 52 percent, hill crest gently curved and highest on the left at 47 percent of image height, descending to the right at 64 percent. Sky occupies upper half, deeply saturated medium cobalt blue at top-right grading to pale blue near left horizon, a few soft white cumulus clouds clustered more on right and a wispy small cloud upper left. Fresh short grass with subtle horizontal wind patterns and large soft sun/shadow patches. Cheerful early 2000s desktop wallpaper photographic feel, rural California spring meadow, full midday sun, tiny dark green distant horizon only at extreme right. Absolutely no trees, buildings, people, objects, flowers, mountains or roads. Crisp natural grass texture, rich but realistic green and blue. Original scene, not a photo crop. Landscape 16:9.

remainingMotionDifferences: Opening camera is split into two fitted moves rather than the reference single 2.77 s pullback; peak path residual 15.4%.
Second opening push peak path residual 6.9%. Upload entry peak path residual 6.4%; menu push peak 10.4%.
Terminal wipe fits as 0.87 s rather than reference 0.30 s bottom-to-top. The adjacent pullback stages merge in the motion fit.
Result box camera settle and globe/window entrances do not follow every measured element track.
Benchmark drift fits 2.067 s sine.in versus reference 3.967 s linear. Benchmark pullback peak residual 2.9%, with an extra late pullback detected.
Closing reveal fits a 23.1% peak camera-path residual and an extra 26% push. The code has the measured 6% camera tween, but the combined iris and content growth still differs.
Final pullback fits 0.17 s late and 0.53 s power2.in instead of 0.70 s power3.in.
Original landscape, ordered dither, modern menu icons, mascot poses, globe cells and irregular iris edge are visual approximations.

pacingFlagsKept.opening: Measured non-monotonic custom camera ease intentionally follows reference acceleration. Do not replace with a generic ease solely to silence detector flags.
pacingFlagsKept.closing: Rapid expanding pixel reveal is a reference content transition. Its fast-growth, short-hold and simultaneous iris/cursor/camera flags remain explicit; it is not certified as a motion match.

soundFlagsKept: Music-only beats intentionally omit extra SFX. Granular iris bursts contain multiple micro-onsets; identity has multiple logo pieces. Full check flags are preserved in motion-diff.json; closing check has no flags.
outsideRevline: image_gen.imagegen created the original hill bitmap because Revline media-reading tools do not generate original raster artwork.
Ran only the upload script returned by uploadMedia, then finishUpload.
Read local skills and Next.js documentation; used filesystem and git tools to preserve this source and verification record.
No ffmpeg, Python or custom media-analysis code was used.
limitations: A multi-frame render request timed out; shorter requests succeeded.
Motion fitting over a changing pixel mask and an original landscape reports camera and element differences; these remain off, not waived as matches.
This is a full-length reconstruction with acknowledged visual and motion differences, not a pixel-exact reproduction.
